facts.title: leek bread pudding
ingredients: 1 cup leeks in 1/2-inch thick slices, white and light green parts only, cleaned and rinsed
6 cups 1-inch-cubed crustless brioche or Pullman loaf
3 cups whole milk, heavy cream or half-and-half or a combination thereof
1/2 cup shredded Comté, Emmanthaler or Swiss cheese
facts.author: Deb Perelman
